title: Days and Months Adventure
summary: Practise the days of the week and the months of the year in English with fun activities.
keyIdeas: Days of the week and months always begin with a capital letter in English.
A week has 7 days and a year has 12 months.
Use 'on' for days (on Monday) and 'in' for months (in May).

activities.prompt: Match each English day with its Spanish meaning.
activities.explanation: Monday means lunes, Friday means viernes and Sunday means domingo in Spanish.
Tuesday comes after Monday. Thursday comes later in the week.
activities.hint: It begins with T and ends with -day.

activities.prompt: There are 7 days in a week.
activities.explanation: A week has exactly 7 days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct day.
activities.explanation: If today is Friday, tomorrow is Saturday.
activities.hint: It is the first day of the weekend.

activities.prompt: Classify the words into days or months.
activities.explanation: Monday, Friday and Sunday are days of the week. July, October and March are months.

activities.prompt: Put these days of the week in the correct order.
activities.explanation: The order is Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct month.
activities.explanation: Christmas Day is in December, the last month of the year.
activities.hint: It is the last month of the year.

activities.prompt: Omar's school week starts on Monday. He has swimming on that day. What day is it?
activities.explanation: Omar's school week begins on Monday.
activities.hint: In Omar's timetable, it is the day school begins after the weekend.

activities.prompt: Put the first four months of the year in order.
activities.explanation: The first four months are January, February, March and April.

activities.prompt: Read the text and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Find the day of the week and the month of Aisha's birthday in the text.
activities.title: Aisha's Special Week
activities.text: Hello! My name is Aisha. Today is Wednesday. My birthday is in September. I have a party on Saturday with my friends.

questions.prompt: What day is today in the story?
In which month is Aisha's birthday?
questions.explanation: Aisha says, 'My birthday is in September'.
